event.goal: OpenAI Chat Completions requires tools[].function.name to match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, but this crate's Core-style tool ids include '.' and ':' (for example fs.list and mcp:tool). Implement to_wire_tool_name so those two characters become '_', and implement mappings so a wire name round-trips back to the original Core id. If two different Core ids collapse to the same wire name (fs.list vs fs_list), mappings must return Err instead of last-wins. Names that are already legal, such as get_time, stay unchanged.
